plan: Queue midlane as primary. It is Goldilocks324's best role at 53.4% over 177 games (overall is 52.3%). Set carry as secondary, not the other way around.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Kira. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Goldilocks324 wins about 4.4 more games per 100 on it.
Goldilocks324's champion pool is 19+ heroes wide and the top three are only 29% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Goldilocks324 is at 752 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 922 — Platinum-level rating has been touched once already; this is a consistency problem, not a ceiling problem.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Kira is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 150 games and Goldilocks324 genuinely out-pilots the field on Kira — about 4.4 more wins per 100 games than the average Kira player. The hours show.

insights.title: Cuban brings out Goldilocks324's best
insights.finding: Goldilocks324's record alongside Cuban Noobster is 56% over 268 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.
